notes.title: Hot Fix Update 1.2.3
notes.content:
- Now alien should not go in the basement after unlocking it.
- Extra sounds added.
- Small bug fixes

notes.title: Bag Report for players
notes.content: [h3]Our first game is finally released! We did our best to deliver a bugless game, but if you encounter any bug that we may have missed or you want to discuss something with us feel free to leave a comment. Also you can use the in game bug report system. Looking forward to discuss with you and answer your questions. We hope you enjoy every moment of "Flightmare"! ːsteamthumbsupː[/h3]

notes.title: FLIGHTMARE IS AVAILABLE NOW
notes.content: [h2]We are very excited to announce the release of our first game "FLIGHTMARE" on Steam. However, we don't stop here. We have many new ideas to implement. There's more to come, so stay tuned. Thank you all for the support! We hope you enjoy this game and we look forward to your feedback![/h2]  ːsteamhappyːːsteamthisː
